title: onboard-eval-digest-actionable-hotlist-2026-03-28
content:
Objective:
Weekly digest focused on newly onboarded open model 'redwood-neo-13b-v2' candidate and promptset-driven regressions discovered in automated onboarding pipeline. Primary goal: surface top failure modes, quick mitigations, and owners for next 7 calendar days. This doc is intentionally concise and action-oriented (operational hotlist).

Snapshot (last 7 days):
- Evaluation window: 2026-03-21 to 2026-03-27
- Sampled requests (onboarding harness): 4,762 prompts across 28 promptsets
- Regression (any metric > delta threshold): 2.4% of sample (115 failures) — up from 1.1% last week
- High-confidence regressions (>=90% CI): 38 cases
- Most impacted product signals: chat-completion (65%), instruction-summarize (18%), code-generation small snippets (12%)

Key metrics (for quick reference):
- Baseline pass rate (pinned model family): 98.7%
- Current candidate pass rate: 96.3%
- Mean hallucination rate (semantic hallucination detector): candidate 3.8% vs baseline 1.4%
- Latency p95 (50 token window): candidate 240ms -> meets SLO for dedicated env, borderline for hosted API under heavy batching

Top failure modes (ranked by frequency and customer impact):
1) Entity hallucination in multi-step QA (43 occurrences)
   - Symptom: model invents non-existent facts when prompt expects extraction from provided context
   - Promptsets hit: legal-contract-extract, support-ticket-resolution, medical-QA-mini
2) Incomplete step decomposition for instruction-following (27 occurrences)
   - Symptom: drops required steps when multi-action instructions provided (e.g., "format, cite, and summarize")
   - Promptsets hit: instr-complete, workflow-synth, user-onboarding-flow
3) Erroneous code output for edge typing (18 occurrences)
   - Symptom: returns Python pseudo-code with incorrect imports or wrong API usage for well-formed input
   - Promptsets hit: code-snippets-small, data-transform-examples
4) Output stochasticity causing test flakiness (27 occurrences overlapping other classes)
   - Symptom: nondeterministic tokenization leads to eval harness mismatch (gold vs candidate) on metrics sensitive to phrasing

Representative examples (anonymized):
- Example A (entity hallucination): prompt asks to extract the clause limiting liability from provided contract snippet; candidate returns a clause referencing an appendix that is not present in the snippet. Baseline returns 'No limitation of liability found' (correct).
- Example B (incomplete step decomposition): prompt: "Provide steps to onboard a new user and verify email + send welcome slack message". Candidate returns onboarding steps but omits Slack notification.
- Example C (code): prompt asks for a small pandas transform; candidate imports 'pandas as pd' but uses 'np' in code body.

Immediate hypotheses (ranked by plausibility):
- H1: Quantization + attention kernel mismatch at sequence boundaries increases token-level confusion for entities (supports hallucination spike). Confidence: medium-high.
- H2: Training data distribution for instruction-following lacks multi-action examples with explicit ordered outputs; candidate model truncates secondary actions. Confidence: medium.
- H3: Sampling temperature defaults differ between baseline and candidate in the onboarding harness; increases stochastic test flakiness. Confidence: high for flakiness; low for entity hallucination.

Quick mitigations (owners and due dates for next 7d):
- A1 (owner: Rafael Gomez) -> Apply deterministic decode config in harness (top-k=1, temperature=0.0) for a gated re-eval of 1,000 failing prompts. Due: 2026-03-30. Linked ticket: ML-873.
- A2 (owner: Mei Chen) -> Run quantization-repro test: compare 8-bit and 16-bit kernel outputs for 200 entity-sensitive prompts; capture kv-cache diffs. Due: 2026-03-31. Linked PR: serving-runtime#1284.
- A3 (owner: Connor Blake) -> Add targeted prompt augmentation to instr-complete promptset (+50 multi-action examples synthesized from real tickets) and re-run coverage check. Due: 2026-04-02. Linked ticket: ENG-4521.
- A4 (owner: Aisha Patel) -> Mark highest-impact promptsets (legal-contract-extract, instr-complete, code-snippets-small) as 'blocker' for onboarding gating; fail fast until regressions <= 0.8%. Due: 2026-03-29.

Monitoring & rollback policy suggestion:
- If high-confidence regression count > 25 after deterministic re-eval, abort rollout and revert to pinned v1.3 for hosted onboarding traffic. Notify infra + SRE.
- Post-mitigation, schedule a follow-up snapshot (smoke + regression) covering top 200 flagged prompts within 48h.

Backlog / longer-term work (owner suggestions):
- L1: Curriculum enrichment for multi-action instruction examples (owner: Applied ML content infra). Target: +3k examples over next 8 weeks.
- L2: Improve hallucination detector to better separate unsupported-in-context responses vs invented facts (owner: Rafael). Target: prototype 2 by 2026-04-20.
- L3: Add infrastructure for token-level kv-cache diffs to identify kernel-level nondeterminism (owner: Serving Runtime).

Dependencies & notes:
- The quantization repro requires a dedicated 40GB GPU slot for isolated runs; coordinate with infra booking.
- Some failing prompts are from recently expanded legal promptset (license added 2026-03-18) — need legal review for any synthetic augmentation.
- Experiment logs and model outputs are in the onboarding S3 bucket: s3://redwood-onboard/evals/2026-03-21_2026-03-27 (request access via internal infra ticket).

Action table (compact):
- Rafael Gomez | deterministic decode re-eval | ML-873 | due 2026-03-30 | priority: P0
- Mei Chen | quantization repro + kv diffs | PR 1284 | due 2026-03-31 | priority: P1
- Connor Blake | promptset augmentation for instr-complete | ENG-4521 | due 2026-04-02 | priority: P1
- Aisha Patel | gate onboarding on 3 blocker promptsets | internal policy | due 2026-03-29 | priority: P0

Appendix: promptset inventory summary (quick):
- legal-contract-extract: 342 prompts (coverage: entity span heavy)
- instr-complete: 410 prompts (coverage: multi-action low)
- code-snippets-small: 280 prompts (focus: API usage correctness)
- support-ticket-resolution: 560 prompts (paraphrase-heavy)

Questions for reviewers:
- Approve gating on the three blocker promptsets for onboarding? (yes/no)
- Are infra reservations for quant repro OK for 2026-03-30?
- Any objections to deterministic decode for re-eval runs?

Next steps:
- Triage meeting scheduled: 2026-03-30 10:00 PT (30m) — invite: applied-ml, serving-runtime, infra, SRE.
- I will update this doc after the deterministic re-eval completes and tag owners with results.

Notes to self: keep this digest short; move deep technical logs to attached experiment artifacts linked above.
